conceptualRoles.name: M09 owner issuance
conceptualRoles.candidateObligation: Future immutable versioned issuer-verifiable M09 receipt for one exact consumer request; no format, signature, transport or adoption.

conceptualRoles.name: Exact owner context
conceptualRoles.candidateObligation: Exact M02 accepted work/revision, applicable M06 attempt only if owner-issued, M09 resource, claims, consumer, intended action, target and provenance; missing associations nonadmitting.

conceptualRoles.name: Owner joint cut
conceptualRoles.candidateObligation: M09 must prove one coherent snapshot+lease cut across all mandatory composite members and their epochs/expiry/revocation; independent twin/lease reads cannot be composed.

conceptualRoles.name: Owner verifier and at-use recheck
conceptualRoles.candidateObligation: Issuer and features, original origin/confidence, exact grant/claim/lease, joint cut, expiry, invalidation, revocation and time-of-use race must be owner-proven.

conceptualRoles.name: Reverse M11 liveness and ACK
conceptualRoles.candidateObligation: Separately verified M11 owner/process observation with UNKNOWN fallback and exact request-coordinated cooperative release; M54/M60 identity and OS authority required; ACCEPTED is not reclaim.

conceptualRoles.name: External owner separation
conceptualRoles.candidateObligation: Even a future valid M09 receipt cannot substitute for M12 placement, M54 permission, M60 OS rights, M58 publication and M02/M06 production/attempt authority.

inheritedHighs.proofRequired: OwnerLivenessRef checks type/state/timestamp and M11 string prefix for non-UNKNOWN, not an approved verifiable intermodule issuer; no adopted M11 producer, freshness/revocation/rights or cooperative-release transport. inheritedHighs.proofRequired: Index-only future owner contracts cannot supply accepted trust/transport, target placement, public SDK/redaction or OS capability; even negative public C needs owner-approved exposure.
